question: Did New World's reviews change after Update 2.0.1 in July 2023?
key_points: Positive share fell from 52.6% (Jan-Jun 2023) to 42.1% (Aug 2023-Jan 2024), p<0.001
Sample-based aspect complaints show no significant change
answer:
- New World's review sentiment changed significantly after Update 2.0.1 in July 2023 [T1].
- Before the update (April to July 2023), the positive review share was 51.21% (n=992) [T1].
- After the update (August to November 2023), the positive review share dropped to 38.59% (n=2319) [T1].
- The difference in positive review share is -0.1262 with a p-value of 1.705e-11, indicating a statistically significant decrease [T1].

question: How did players react to Total War: WARHAMMER III Patch 4.1?
key_points: Strongly positive reaction: positive share 40.7% before vs 75.7% after (p<0.001)
Bug and price complaints fell significantly (bugs ~23% -> ~5%, price ~35% -> ~16%)
answer: Player reactions to **Total War: WARHAMMER III Patch 4.1** showed a significant increase in positive sentiment. Review data from [T1] indicates that after the patch (split date: 2023-11-21), the positive review share rose from **41.41% to 73.75%** (difference: **+32.35%**, p-value: **0.0**), reflecting strong approval. Complaints about **bugs** dropped sharply from **23.24% to 4.58%** (p-value: **0.0**), and **price** complaints fell from **35.04% to 15.65%** (p-value: **0.0003**), suggesting improvements in stability and perceived value. However, **performance** complaints increased slightly (from 0.84% to 2.24%), though this was not statistically significant (p-value: **0.2906**). The patch notes [1] highlighted bug fixes, UI improvements, and balance adjustments, aligning with the observed sentiment shift.

- **Performance Improvements:**
  - Optimized various systems to reduce frame-time spikes and improve overall simulation performance, optimized UI rendering, and reduced overhead of rendering curves in UI [1].

- **General Fixes & Improvements:**
  - Addressed several bugs related to UI elements, building upgrades, transportation lines, and city information display [1].

question: How does Balatro's Plasma Deck change scoring, and how do you unlock it?
key_points: Plasma Deck balances (averages) Chips and Mult before multiplying, and doubles base Blind size
Unlocked by winning a run on Blue Stake difficulty or harder
answer:
- **Scoring Change**: The Plasma Deck squares the average of the Chip and Mult scores, resulting in a higher hand score compared to the standard method. For example, a Level 1 flush (Q, 10, 9, 7, 6) scores 1,681 with the Plasma Deck, compared to 308 without it. [T1], [2]
- **Unlock Method**: The Plasma Deck is unlocked by winning a run on the Blue Stake difficulty or higher. [4]
- **Blind Size**: The size of Blinds is doubled when playing with the Plasma Deck. [2]

documents.text: This method requires the Plasma since this Deck squares the average of your Chip and Mult scores, enabling higher scoring.

documents.text:
number: 14
title: Plasma Deck
limit: Balance blue Chips and red Mult when calculating score for played hand red X2 base Blind size
unlock: Win a run with any deck on the Blue Stake difficulty or harder

The Plasma Deck is one of the decks you can unlock when playing the game, by winning a run on the Blue Stake difficulty. This deck changes how a hand score is calculated and doubles the size of Blinds.

For example if you had a Level 1 flush (Q, 10, 9, 7, 6), the hand score would normally be

77 × 4 = 308

However with the Plasma deck, the total Chips and total Mult are averaged together (or balanced) before they get multiplied.

78 + 4 = 82
82 / 2 = 41
41 × 41 = 1,681

This is a significantly higher number and is offset by having Blind sizes twice as high when playing this deck. In fact, the hand score will always be higher after balancing (except in the case that its Chips and Mult are equal). The hand score is calculated as .

Balatro has 8 stakes, which add progressively ramping difficulty modifiers to each game. To unlock a stake for a deck, you must complete a run using the highest currently unlocked stake. Progression through the different stakes is unique to each starting deck, meaning that you must unlock each stake individually for each deck.

The 8 stakes, listed in the order that they are unlocked. Note that each stake applies the modifiers of all previous stakes.

documents.label: Balatro · wiki · undated · Plasma Deck > Synergies
documents.text:
You want to aim for the highest raw number boosts to Chips and Mult. Since Chips start off at a higher number, most Jokers and Consumables boost Chips with a larger raw number than Mult (e.g. Bonus Card's +30 Chips vs Mult Card's +4 Mult). This is roughly balanced on other decks, but on the Plasma Deck, Chips and Mult equally contribute to the hand score, so using cards with large +Chips will result in a much higher score.

2,4,6,8,10 with Even Steven = 10 Chips and 10 Mult
A,3,5,7,9 with Odd Todd = 77 Chips and 77 Mult

In a normal deck, focusing on only leads to a non-optimal distribution, which is fixed with the Plasma Deck and can result in much higher final scores with identical builds and the same hand.

Normal Deck Scoring: 100 × 10,000 = 1,000,000
Plasma Deck Scoring: 5,050 × 5,050 = 25,502,500

Chip boosters:

any Jokers that add large +Chips
Bonus Card enhancement (+30 Chips)
Foil edition (+50 Chips)
Red seal will trigger the card twice, so you get twice the Chips
higher rank cards (Ace card's +11 Chips vs Two card's +2 Chips)

However in later Antes, Chips only carry so far since they can only be additive in the base game (i.e. there are no XChips jokers in the base game). On the other hand, Mult can be multiplicative. While XMult is slow early on, with a high enough base Mult, this boost can be much greater than +Chips in the late game. documents.text: While starting with a standard 52-card deck (for most Decks), in Balatro, there are many ways to change the components of the deck. Along with getting strong Jokers, leveling up hands by Planet Cards, Deck Manipulation is also an important way to get higher scores, and catching up with the game, which is often neglected by new players. It is of more importance with higher Stakes, Painted Deck, and many Challenges, due to the scarcity of effects from Jokers. Also, Deck Manipulation is necessary for many play styles (for example, Red Seal Steel Kings) to get extremely high scores.

question: Did New World's reviews change after Update 2.0.1 in July 2023?
key_points: Positive share fell from 52.6% (Jan-Jun 2023) to 42.1% (Aug 2023-Jan 2024), p<0.001
Sample-based aspect complaints show no significant change
answer: After Update 2.0.1 in July 2023, New World's reviews showed a statistically significant decline in positive sentiment. The review trend tool (T1) found that the positive share dropped from 0.5255 (before July 2023) to 0.4214 (after July 2023), a difference of -0.1041, with a p-value of 1.96×10⁻¹⁴ [T1]. This indicates a significant decrease in positive reviews post-update. The review sentiment tool (T2) also noted a smaller decline (diff: -0.0807, p=0.2265), though not statistically significant, likely due to sampling differences. Sources [1] and [5] corroborate ongoing criticism of the game’s development and content quality.

question: How does Balatro's Plasma Deck change scoring, and how do you unlock it?
key_points: Plasma Deck balances (averages) Chips and Mult before multiplying, and doubles base Blind size
Unlocked by winning a run on Blue Stake difficulty or harder
answer:
- **Scoring Change**: The Plasma Deck changes the scoring calculation by averaging the total Chips and total Mult before squaring the result. For example, a hand with 78 Chips and 4 Mult would normally score 308, but with Plasma, it scores 1,681 ([(78+4)/2]^2). This deck also doubles the size of Blinds. [1]

- **Unlock Method**: The Plasma Deck unlocks when you win a run on the Blue Stake difficulty or higher. [4]

- **Example Scores**:
  - Normal Deck: 100 Chips and 10,000 Mult = 1,000,000
  - Plasma Deck: 5,050 Chips and 5,050 Mult = 25,502,500 [1]

documents.text: This method requires the Plasma since this Deck squares the average of your Chip and Mult scores, enabling higher scoring.

title: Plasma Deck
limit: Balance blue Chips and red Mult when calculating score for played hand red X2 base Blind size
unlock: Win a run with any deck on the Blue Stake difficulty or harder

The Plasma Deck is one of the decks you can unlock when playing the game, by winning a run on the Blue Stake difficulty. This deck changes how a hand score is calculated and doubles the size of Blinds.

For example if you had a Level 1 flush (Q, 10, 9, 7, 6), the hand score would normally be

77 × 4 = 308

However with the Plasma deck, the total Chips and total Mult are averaged together (or balanced) before they get multiplied.

78 + 4 = 82
82 / 2 = 41
41 × 41 = 1,681

This is a significantly higher number and is offset by having Blind sizes twice as high when playing this deck. In fact, the hand score will always be higher after balancing (except in the case that its Chips and Mult are equal). The hand score is calculated as .

Balatro has 8 stakes, which add progressively ramping difficulty modifiers to each game. To unlock a stake for a deck, you must complete a run using the highest currently unlocked stake. Progression through the different stakes is unique to each starting deck, meaning that you must unlock each stake individually for each deck.

The 8 stakes, listed in the order that they are unlocked. Note that each stake applies the modifiers of all previous stakes.

documents.text:
You want to aim for the highest raw number boosts to Chips and Mult. Since Chips start off at a higher number, most Jokers and Consumables boost Chips with a larger raw number than Mult (e.g. Bonus Card's +30 Chips vs Mult Card's +4 Mult). This is roughly balanced on other decks, but on the Plasma Deck, Chips and Mult equally contribute to the hand score, so using cards with large +Chips will result in a much higher score.

2,4,6,8,10 with Even Steven = 10 Chips and 10 Mult
A,3,5,7,9 with Odd Todd = 77 Chips and 77 Mult

In a normal deck, focusing on only leads to a non-optimal distribution, which is fixed with the Plasma Deck and can result in much higher final scores with identical builds and the same hand.

Normal Deck Scoring: 100 × 10,000 = 1,000,000
Plasma Deck Scoring: 5,050 × 5,050 = 25,502,500

Chip boosters:

any Jokers that add large +Chips
Bonus Card enhancement (+30 Chips)
Foil edition (+50 Chips)
Red seal will trigger the card twice, so you get twice the Chips
higher rank cards (Ace card's +11 Chips vs Two card's +2 Chips)

However in later Antes, Chips only carry so far since they can only be additive in the base game (i.e. there are no XChips jokers in the base game). On the other hand, Mult can be multiplicative. While XMult is slow early on, with a high enough base Mult, this boost can be much greater than +Chips in the late game. documents.text: While starting with a standard 52-card deck (for most Decks), in Balatro, there are many ways to change the components of the deck. Along with getting strong Jokers, leveling up hands by Planet Cards, Deck Manipulation is also an important way to get higher scores, and catching up with the game, which is often neglected by new players. It is of more importance with higher Stakes, Painted Deck, and many Challenges, due to the scarcity of effects from Jokers.
